mechanism.base: Water ends fire, the old texts say: the many overcome the few, and rain outlasts any blaze. Heat climbs and spreads wherever it finds fuel, and water is the one thing it cannot consume. Poured over a flame, water does not argue with it. It takes the heat into itself, rises as steam and leaves the ground cool and dark, and every fire that meets water learns its true size.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: With too little Water, the blaze meets nothing that can stop it: every plan catches, no fire gets put out, and the heat runs wherever it likes. Take on one deadline someone else sets.
mechanism.friction_turn: With too much Water, the rain keeps falling on a small flame: every rule weighs more than it should, and the light shrinks to stay lit. Keep one evening a week with nothing due.

catalyst.clause: the blaze meets nothing that can stop it
catalyst.remedy: Take on one deadline someone else sets.

friction.clause: the rain keeps falling on a small flame
friction.remedy: Keep one evening a week with nothing due.

wide.clause: There is no shortage of Water in you, the rain that keeps the blaze its right size.
wide.remedy: Use it. Take the deadline and meet it.

missing.clause: No rain anywhere near the blaze: nothing outside you says when enough is enough.
missing.remedy: Borrow rules: one person above you, one date you did not pick.

spared.clause: No rain falls on this low flame, and better so: nothing is pressing the light out.
spared.remedy: Nothing to ease here. Build the fire up first.

thin.clause: Only a little rain reaches this flame, and the light holds its heat under it.
thin.remedy: Keep it small. Take rules as they come, one at a time.

excess.clause: Water this deep puts a low fire out: so many rules answered that the light itself goes dark.
excess.remedy: Answer fewer demands. Add fuel before the next one.

function.definition_catalyst: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Water makes it cool and deep, and a rule settles in quietly. As a catalyst, the pull stays faint, so you answer a crisis more than you build a career and let your rank slip.
function.definition_friction: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Water keeps it deep, and rules sink in to stay. As a friction, the pull turns inward, so you hold your rank rather than risk it on a crisis and pay in tests never taken.
function.advise_catalyst: You do your best work with a date on it and someone waiting at the other end. Give each big plan a finish line before you start it. Once a month, hand a decision to someone whose call you will keep. Tell one person your deadline. Set a stop time before you begin.
function.advise_friction: Seek Wood, the Mind energy. Wood is fuel that grows: it drinks the rain and turns it into something a fire can use. Let it hold what Water pours on you. You take every rule to heart faster than you take anything in. Learn one thing a week nobody asked you for. Give each new demand a night to sit.

candidates.cta_verdict: You take a rule in quietly and keep it for years, and you would rather answer to a standard you chose than to a voice raised at you.

mechanism.base: The many prevail over the few, and so water commands fire: one flame meets the falling rain, and however bright it burned, the rain does not run out first. What survives learns to burn banked and careful. Rain is the blaze's schooling: after it, fire keeps its heat closer and wastes less light.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: Run thin, nothing checks the burn: enthusiasm with no depth gauge, light that has never been rained on. Your chart asks for water. Seek the cold reviewer, the quiet counsel.
mechanism.friction_turn: Run heavy, the rain never lifts: constant drizzle on every spark, caution soaking the kindling before it catches. Step out of the rain. A doused fire serves no one.

catalyst.clause: Nothing checks the burn: enthusiasm with no depth gauge, light that has never been rained on.
catalyst.remedy: Seek the cold reviewer, the quiet counsel.

friction.clause: The rain never lifts: constant drizzle on every spark, caution soaking the kindling before it catches.
friction.remedy: A doused fire serves no one.

wide.clause: There is no shortage of Water in you, the depth that keeps the burn honest.
wide.remedy: Take the cold review. Let it steady you.

missing.clause: Nothing checks the burn: enthusiasm without a gauge, light that has never been rained on.

spared.clause: Water runs absent, and nothing douses the flame: no drizzle on the spark, no second-guessing.
spared.remedy: Keep it. Choose one check you trust.

thin.clause: Water runs thin and unwanted: a light rain, easy to shine through.

excess.clause: Weak fire drowns in strong water: checks past what the flame can survive, caution putting the light out.
excess.remedy: Get out of the rain. Add wood.

function.definition_catalyst: Water is your Order, and as a catalyst, it is the cool check your intensity needs: reviews, budgets, one person whose calm questions slow you down before the leap. Your best decisions have all survived a night of doubt.
function.definition_friction: Water is your Order, and as a friction, it is caution soaking through everything: every plan reviewed until the moment passes, every spark second-guessed into a maybe. The checking now costs more than the mistakes would, and the hardest judge of the flame is you.
function.advise_catalyst: Discipline, for you, is imported, so import it well. Sleep on anything irreversible. Keep a reviewer you cannot charm and show them everything big. Put a cool number on every hot plan before saying yes.
function.advise_friction: Prudence past its dose becomes fear with a clipboard. Give small decisions a five-minute timer. Reserve real review for the truly irreversible. Once a month, act on a warm impulse the same day it arrives and audit the result later.

$original.cta_verdict: Pressure reaches you cool and quiet, and the calm authorities you let bank your fire are the reason it lasts the night.
